metadata.frameDescription: SGP4 True Equator Mean Equinox (Earth-centered inertial-like)
metadata.selectionRule: Latest preceding Russian TLE for the pre-manoeuvre baseline, then nearest Russian TLE to each milestone; Dec 8 USA TLE for the baseline and Dec 31 USA TLE thereafter; one fixed triplet per animation

scenarios.title: Initial close configuration
scenarios.description: Pre-manoeuvre element sets place USA 245 and both recently separated Russian spacecraft within roughly 55 km. This is a reconstructed snapshot, not an observed burn sequence.

scenarios.title: Separated configuration
scenarios.description: After the major Kosmos 2543 element changes, the reconstructed spacecraft positions are thousands of kilometres apart. USA 245 uses its December 31 solution propagated backward.

scenarios.title: Close again
scenarios.description: With USA 245 recovered and contemporary Russian elements, Kosmos 2543 returns to a modeled close configuration near 21 km.

scenarios.title: Both Russian spacecraft close
scenarios.description: Contemporary Russian elements place both Kosmos spacecraft within roughly 110 km of USA 245. The USA 245 solution is now 25 days old, so this later snapshot is less certain.
